children.description:
I found a homeless shelter in the zip code area 98004. The shelter is called "Men's Eastside Winter Shelter" and is located at 515B 116th Ave NE, Bellevue, WA 98004. 

The shelter can be contacted at (425) 296-3797 or via email at volunteer@cfhomeless.org. 

For more information, you can visit their official website at http://www.cfhomeless.org/winter-shelter/. They are also active on social media with a Twitter account (@cf_homeless) and a Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/www.cfhomeless.org). 

The shelter provides overnight services from 7:30 pm to 7:30 am and is accessible via the 271 bus. Priority for shelter space is given to men who have stayed there the previous night. It is the only low-barrier shelter for men on the Eastside.
